commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

connectionId.description: A key-manager connection's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

basePath.description: Where Move keeps the harness's secrets on the connection, each entry one level below it: for OpenBao or Vault a KV mount and exactly one project segment (personal/harness), so an entry sits two levels under its mount.
